notablePrerequisites: Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
description:
Cast Micromancer by paying {3}{U}.
Micromancer enters the battlefield and triggers, searching your library for Dark Ritual and putting it into your hand.
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Micromancer.
Micromancer triggers, searching your library for Scheming Symmetry and putting it into your hand.
Dark Ritual resolves, adding {B}{B}{B} and going to the bottom of your library.
Cast Scheming Symmetry by paying {B}, targeting any two players.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Micromancer.
Micromancer triggers, searching your library for Dark Ritual and putting it into your hand.
Scheming Symmetry triggers, exiling a card from each targeted opponent's library due to Opposition Agent's effect, and going to the bottom of your library.
Repeat from step 3.
